gate_plug_one_pass.claim: a flow holding a porous plug and point bodies one pass steps as the monolithic step whose operator holds the plug's resistivity, and the plug's face pressures read every held body's force

prediction.unit: each quantity's largest miss over its derived line (gate 1's and face_pressure_miss's)
prediction.why: the plug's resistivity enters the field's operator, which the elimination's unit solves and the monolithic step both use; the faces are recomputed from the step's own answer, so they miss only by rounding

control.plant: the plug's faces read without the held bodies' forces (the plug's own reading before the merge)
control.expected_rate: caught at every draw, both dtypes (its own test, test_control_a_plugs_faces_read_without_the_held_bodies_forces_miss_at_every_draw)
control.resolution: a body's force's own pressure on the faces against the reading's rounding

gate_plug_one_pass.if_wrong: the elimination does not see the plug, or the faces read another right-hand side than the step solved
gate_plug_one_pass.cannot_discriminate_if: the control's faces within their line (a body's force with no pressure on the faces)
